findings: iOS push delivery silent failure — both notification services hardcode platform: 'android'. iOS tokens will be stored but Expo Push will not deliver correctly. Fix by detecting Platform.OS in both NotificationService files.

Single-token column used for dispatch — sendPushNotification reads users.push_token, not user_push_tokens. A driver logging in on a second device silently kills notifications to the first device. Update sendPushNotification to fan out to user_push_tokens, or document the single-device constraint.

Tip UI silently discarded — RatingScreen collects a tip selection (0/500/1000/2000 TSh) that is never included in the POST body and has no server-side column. Remove the tip UI or implement it end-to-end.

Ratings duplicate 409 has a TOCTOU gap — the duplicate SELECT runs before the transaction opens, so concurrent first-time ratings for the same trip will 500 on constraint violation instead of 409. Move the duplicate check inside the transaction or catch error code 23505 and return 409.
